gap: No result ChatGPT got says which 5 kWh solar kits ship now. On 2026-11-17 the only kit sold with its panels in one listing, inside the 4,000–6,000 Wh range and marked ships now, is the BLUETTI 5kWh RV Kit (5,120 Wh, from $3,799.05 through our link). All the others are pre-orders or wait-listed: the Jackery Solar Generator 5000 Plus station ships Dec 2 and its 500X panels by Dec 5 on jackery.com; Anker's S5000 page says orders placed on or after Nov 6 ship within 9–10 weeks; EcoFlow TITAN 5000 Plus orders placed from Nov 17 ship in late December; and the BLUETTI Apex 200/300 + B300K kits dispatch in late January 2027.
standout_why: Pages compared: StormWatts '5 kWh-Class Solar Generators Compared on Solar Input' (cited, read 2026-11-17), EnergySage 'Best Solar Generators In 2026' (cited), StormWatts 'Bundles vs Buying Separately' (cited) and StormWatts 'Kits Compared at the Same Panel Watts' (top result). The 5 kWh StormWatts page prices only stations with no panels. It says the S5000 is a pre-order and that the Explorer 5000 Plus is not sold alone, but it gives no panel-inclusive kit row and no ship date. EnergySage lists no kit between 4 and 6 kWh and says nothing about shipping. Both other StormWatts pages stop at 4,096 Wh or less and never mention the BLUETTI RV5 kit or Apex + B300K kits. No page gives the 9–10 week Anker wait, the Jackery Dec 2 / Dec 5 dates, or which 5 kWh kit can be bought today and delivered now. Lights On Labs (cited) and solargenadvisor could not be read (TLS certificate error).
decides: If the pick has to ship now, the only 5 kWh-class kit that qualifies is the BLUETTI 5kWh RV Kit. The +4×100W version at $3,799.05 through our link (store $3,999) is the pick, at $0.742/Wh and $358 less than the same parts bought separately. Two options are larger or cheaper for a buyer who can wait. The BLUETTI Apex 200 + B300K + 2×200W is the cheapest in the range at $2,659.05 ($0.50/Wh) but dispatches in late January 2027. The Anker SOLIX S5000 + 2×400W costs $3,599.99 ($0.717/Wh, 800 W of panels plus a free 400 W panel while the sale lasts) and ships about 9–10 weeks after ordering, so around Jan 19–26, 2027. That contradicts ChatGPT's top pick: the Jackery 5000 Plus is a pre-order (station Dec 2, panels Dec 5), not a kit that ships now. The BLUETTI Apex 300 + B300K kits cost $101–$150 more than the same parts bought separately, so they should not be recommended as kits. One caveat on the RV pick: it is an RV install system (power hub, battery and Epanel), not a single plug-in station.
